<summary>
1. Primary Request and Intent:
   The user requested creation of a comprehensive SVG architecture diagram (`architecture.svg`) that visualizes the full methodology and architecture of the multi-task snow prediction model, based on the `Docs/METHODOLOGY.md` document. The user specifically asked for "full details of the methodology and architecture and why and how questions including the rationals" — meaning the diagram should cover not just the model structure but also design decisions and their justifications across all 8 training versions (V1-V7b).

   **Broader project context**: This is part of Phase 13 (visualization/documentation) of the Nordic Snow Monitoring project. Prior phases completed: data pipeline (SMHI + MESAN), model architecture, training V1-V7b (8 versions), documentation overhaul, and Result_analyser.ipynb notebook update (V1-V5 → V1-V7b).

2. Key Technical Concepts:
   - **Multi-task deep learning**: Single SharedEncoder (LSTM + Attention) with 3 task-specific heads
   - **SharedEncoder**: LSTM(2 layers, 128 hidden) → MultiheadAttention(8 heads, Q=h_n, K=V=lstm_out) → Residual + LayerNorm → Dropout(0.3) → context (batch, 128)
   - **Head A (Spatial)**: MLP 128→64→32→1, MSE loss, predicts current snow depth
   - **Head B (Temporal)**: MLP 128→64→7, MSE loss, 7-day forecast (MLP beats LSTM decoder)
   - **Head D (Anomaly)**: MLP 128→64→32→1, BCEWithLogitsLoss(pos_weight=25), extreme event forecasting at day 31
   - **V7b loss weights**: λ = (1.0, 0.1, 2.0) achieving gradient distribution ~27% spatial, ~48% temporal, ~25% anomaly
   - **Data**: MESAN gridded analysis + SMHI station observations, 424 stations, 12 features, 30-day sequences
   - **Key design decisions**: MLP over LSTM decoder (8.8K vs 25K params, 12% vs 47% val divergence), BCE over Focal loss (magnitude mismatch: focal 50x too small), Fixed over Uncertainty weights (drift problem), AUC ceiling at ~0.77 (forecasting task, not detection)
   - **V7b results**: Spatial RMSE 1.01cm (R²=0.999), Temporal RMSE 5.61cm, Anomaly AUC 0.770, F1 0.220
   - **SVG visualization**: Professional infographic-style with color-coded sections, gradients, drop shadows, rationale callouts

   - **`/scratch/gdemil24/RISE/nordic-snow-monitoring/architecture.svg`** (CREATED)
     - Main deliverable of this session — comprehensive SVG architecture diagram
     - 688 lines, 56KB, viewBox 0 0 1440 3420
     - Valid XML with 92 rectangles, 329 text elements, 16 lines, 12 paths
     - 6 sections: Title, Data Pipeline, Model Architecture, Loss & Training, Design Decisions, Performance Summary
     - Color scheme: blue (data), teal/green (model/encoder), orange (training/temporal), purple (anomaly/rationale), green (performance)
     - Includes detailed "Why" callout boxes for each major design decision

   - **`/scratch/gdemil24/RISE/nordic-snow-monitoring/src/models/encoder.py`** (READ)
     - SharedEncoder class with LSTM + MultiheadAttention + LayerNorm + Residual + Dropout
     - Key forward pass: lstm_out, (h_n, c_n) = self.lstm(x) → query=h_n.unsqueeze(1) → attention(Q, K=lstm_out, V=lstm_out) → layer_norm(attn_out + context) → dropout → projection
     - Also contains PositionalEncoding class (unused in production)

   - **`/scratch/gdemil24/RISE/nordic-snow-monitoring/src/models/heads.py`** (READ)
     - SpatialHead: nn.Sequential(Linear(128,64), ReLU, Dropout, Linear(64,32), ReLU, Dropout, Linear(32,1))
     - TemporalHeadMLP: nn.Sequential(Linear(128,64), ReLU, Dropout, Linear(64,7)) — production head
     - TemporalHead: LSTM decoder that repeats context 7 times (legacy, V1-V2)
     - TemporalHeadAutoregressive: GRU cell with prediction feedback (V4, abandoned)
     - AnomalyHead: nn.Sequential(Linear(128,64), ReLU, Dropout, Linear(64,32), ReLU, Dropout, Linear(32,1))

   - **`/scratch/gdemil24/RISE/nordic-snow-monitoring/src/models/multitask.py`** (READ)
     - MultiTaskSnowModel: combines SharedEncoder + head_A (SpatialHead) + head_B (configurable: mlp/lstm/autoregressive) + head_D (AnomalyHead)
     - Forward: encodes input → passes context to selected heads → returns dict {'A': ..., 'B': ..., 'D': ...}
     - SingleTaskModel: baseline with same encoder + single head
